Integrated Solutions for Plastic Injection Molding and Mold Development
#

Chia Kuan brings over 36 years of professional experience to the field of plastic injection molding. Our approach centers on innovation, close client collaboration, and the application of advanced technology throughout every stage of the process—from prototyping to full-scale production.
